verdict.rationale: Bland's docs cover outbound call dispatch, including high-volume batch campaigns, and creating inbound phone numbers. They also document inbound and outbound SIP, bringing your own Twilio numbers, number porting, and CLI-based phone number configuration, with post-call webhooks for results. Missing for 10: explicit API reference detail for programmatic number purchase/provisioning endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration that the inbound and outbound API flows work as described.
